svg.title: Journey so far
svg.desc: Timeline: 2023, joined NIT Silchar for a B.Tech in Electronics and Instrumentation. By 6th semester, Department Rank 2. May to July 2026, SN Bose Summer Research Intern at NIT Silchar, building EdgeMind. September to October 2026, shipping software: placement-prep, product-catalog-service and kestrel-rtos. Now: placement season, open to software roles for 2026–27.
